correctness.rationale: Path edge validity is equivalent to each 00 pair having adjacent 2 just outside. Exhaustive zero-run classification yields a bijection and a two-state positive-letter transfer. Direct 2x2 inversion proves the rational function. Laurent substitution x=y/t,z=t^2 proves weight floor(n/2) and extracts y/(1-y^2-y^4), 1/(1-y^2-y^4)^2; the Fibonacci and convolution formulas follow. An independent exhaustive original-definition verifier checks 797161 words, and finite rational/minimum checks reach length 160.
